newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu bid-only after news on engine talks with GM.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu bid-only after news on engine talks with GM.

text.p: Shares of Isuzu Motors Ltd were bid-only on Friday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange after the company said it was negotiating to sell newly developed engines to General Motors Corp.
Isuzu was bid-only at 545 yen at 0113 GMT. It closed at 505 yen on Thursday.
An Isuzu spokesman told Reuters earlier on Friday that the company had developed fuel-efficient 2,500 cc and 3,000 cc diesel engines and that it was negotiating to sell the new engines to GM.
He said Isuzu expected GM to buy the engines, although nothing had yet been decided.
The engines, to be unveiled at a car show in Switzerland in early March, are aimed mainly at the European market, the spokesman said.
Isuzu is 37.4 percent owned by GM.
